gymcoach-db.description: Direct PostgreSQL access to the GymCoach database. Use for schema inspection, data queries and migration debugging.

context7.description: Live documentation for Next.js, Prisma, Tailwind, Shadcn UI, Zod and other dependencies. Always resolve library-id before writing code that uses a dependency.

filesystem.description: Read and write files in the GymCoach project directory.

composio.description: Composio hosted MCP gateway: exposes Composio tools + 1000+ app toolkits (Gmail, GitHub, Calendar, etc.) with managed OAuth. Toolkit 'composio'/'composio_search'/'browser_tool' need no external app connection. Authenticate with `opencode mcp auth composio` (OAuth with the existing Composio account).
